summary.en: Aurobindo is generic-heavy; its disclosed biologics development pipeline is concentrated in CuraTeQ biosimilars. European filings, further-market trials and manufacturing expansion are central to that pipeline.
summary.zh: Aurobindo 以仿制药为主;其披露的生物药开发管线集中于 CuraTeQ 生物类似药。欧洲申报、其他市场的试验以及产能扩张是该管线的核心。

ind.zh: 呼吸系统和过敏性疾病

watch.en: Denosumab and omalizumab are under European review; further North American filings are planned.
watch.zh: Denosumab 和 omalizumab 正在接受欧洲审评;计划进一步在北美申报。

watch.en: CuraTeQ is adding 10,000 L of mammalian capacity and repurposing vaccine capacity for completion by end-2027.
watch.zh: CuraTeQ 正在新增 10,000 L 哺乳动物细胞产能,并改造疫苗产能,计划于 2027 年底前完成。

watch.en: September net cash including investments was $189 million; quarterly R&D spending was INR 376 crore.
watch.zh: 9 月含投资的净现金为 $189 million;季度研发支出为 INR 376 crore。

gaps: No conventional full-group innovative-drug pipeline or published phase totals verified.
Current biosimilar targets, detailed indications and discovery origins were not explicit in the reviewed presentation and remain null or broad.

Preclinical trastuzumab SC and pertuzumab programs are excluded because clinical entry is still prospective.
Already marketed biosimilars are excluded; the selection is therefore limited to four assets.
